selection: Restore exposed R8001_M8004; no new independent meeting claim.
speakerMapping: Each near reference nonempty (start,end,text) sequence must match exactly one far tier; preserve original names. Then inspect own/other solo energy and same-utterance acoustic correlation, rather than trusting filenames alone.

fineClock.selection: R2: nearest continuous target-only core of >=1.5s after0.1s edge margins, within each respective third. Whole-utterance requirement in R1 left one person unmeasured despite213.66s target-only audio; use interior cores for CLOCK measurements only, never partial-word CER.
fineClock.method: Bandpass normalized cross-correlation over actual overlapping PCM; maximize absolute coefficient, retain polarity. Acoustic propagation is included in measured lag.
fineClock.lagSign: Positive means near time t corresponds to far time t+lag.

bleed: Median RMS on annotated own-only, each other-only, true-overlap, and no-annotated-speech 20ms frames within annotation scope. This is relative leakage evidence, not clean-source SDR or measured transcription accuracy.
rawPcmCheck: Compare bounded first/middle/last sample reads with scipy WAV mmap reader, including extensible PCM16 header. No audio recoding.
